description: Core Netlink Interface implementation providing socket connection, message sending, receiving, and acknowledgment handling functions.

methods.name: nl_connect
methods.description: Creates and connects a netlink socket with specified protocol, binds it, and initializes socket parameters.

methods.name: nl_close
methods.description: Closes the netlink socket and resets socket parameters.

methods.name: nl_sendto
methods.description: Sends raw data over the netlink socket.

methods.name: nl_sendmsg
methods.description: Sends a netlink message with control over the sendmsg() header.

methods.name: nl_send
methods.description: Sends a netlink message, setting destination and credentials if provided.

methods.name: nl_send_auto_complete
methods.description: Prepares and sends a netlink message, auto-filling header fields like pid, sequence, and flags.

methods.name: nl_send_simple
methods.description: Builds and sends a simple netlink message with specified type, flags, and payload.

methods.name: nl_recv
methods.description: Receives a netlink message, allocating buffer and extracting message content, address, and credentials.

methods.name: nl_recvmsgs
methods.description: Receives and processes a set of netlink messages using callbacks, handling multipart and errors.

methods.name: nl_wait_for_ack
methods.description: Waits for an acknowledgment (ACK) message for the latest sent netlink message.
